levels.description: Does not naturally recover SP, but gains SP when you gain Production Modules; when skill is activated, generates <@ba.enemy>Shielded Senior Casters</> on nearby ground tiles (grants <@ba.drop>Caster Advancement Tokens</> and <@ba.drop>Supporter Advancement Tokens</> once defeated) and drops a small amount of <@ba.drop>Skill Handbooks</> along with a random chance for <@ba.drop>Production Modules</>
